Name: Lnh's Cat Farm
Author: liunianhui
Description:
[left][size=4][color=#ffff00]接受地图绘制委托，如果你正在制作mod，需要找人绘制地图，那么请联系我。
[/color][color=#ffff00]Accept the commission of map drawing. If you are making mod and need to find someone to draw a map, please contact me.[/color][/size]

[color=#00ff00][size=5]猫猫农场（Cat Farm）[/size]
[size=4]这是一个全新的猫猫主题农场，灵感来自于我的QQ群友和Mixa，感谢他们。
This is a brand new cat themed farm, inspired by my QQ friends and Mixa. Thank you to them.[/size]

[size=4]整个农场所有瓷砖都可以种植作物，空间很大，大家自由发挥。
All the tiles on the farm can be planted with crops, with a large space for everyone to freely use.[/size][/color]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5]兼容性：[/size]
[size=4]几乎兼容所有mod，如果你发现bug，请告诉我，我会第一时间修改。
Almost compatible with all mods. If you find any bugs, please let me know and I will make the necessary modifications as soon as possible.[/size][/color]

[color=#ffff00][size=5]前置mod：[/size]
[/color][color=#ffff00][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] （必须的，necessary）
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url]  （必须的，necessary, Use the latest version）
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9063]SmolHooman's Wild Animals[/url] （1.5游戏版本需要，如果不想让农场内出现野生动物，你只需要删除[CP] Wild Animals文件夹。1.5 game version requires, if you don't want wild animals to appear on the farm, you just need to delete the [CP] Wild Animals folder）[/size][/color]﻿﻿﻿﻿
